description: Rabbi Nissim Chaim Moshe Mizrachi’s 18th-century responsa and insights on the four sections of the Shulchan Arukh.  Complete Responsa text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Responsa are written answers to specific legal questions, addressed by a scholar to a community or an individual. A responsum is a dated, situated ruling and is presented with its collection rather than as a universal statute.
